arxiv-2302-09429.title: NU-AIR - A Neuromorphic Urban Aerial Dataset for Detection and Localization of Pedestrians and Vehicles
arxiv-2302-09429.creator: Craig Iaboni, Thomas Kelly, Pramod Abichandani
arxiv-2302-09429.description: Abstract This paper presents an open-source aerial neuromorphic dataset that captures pedestrians and vehicles moving in an urban environment. The dataset, titled NU-AIR, features over 70 minutes of event footage acquired with a 640 × \times 480 resolution neuromorphic sensor mounted on a quadrotor operating in an urban environment.

arxiv-2307-05608.description: Abstract New regulations and increased awareness of data privacy have led to the deployment of new and more efficient differentially private mechanisms across public institutions and industries. Ensuring the correctness of these mechanisms is therefore crucial to ensure the proper protection of data.

arxiv-2311-13365.title: A Bounded Regret Strategy for Linear Dynamics with Unknown Control
arxiv-2311-13365.creator: Jacob Carruth
arxiv-2311-13365.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jacob Carruth. We consider a simple linear control problem in which a single parameter b b , describing the effect of the control variable, is unknown and must be learned. We work in the setting of agnostic control: we allow b b to be any real number and we do not assume that we have a prior belief about b b . For any fixed time horizon, we produce a strategy whose expected cost is within a constant factor of the best possible.

arxiv-2409-13116.title: BGDB: Bernoulli-Gaussian Decision Block with Improved Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
arxiv-2409-13116.creator: Chengkun Sun, Jinqian Pan, Russell Stevens Terry, Jiang Bian, Jie Xu
arxiv-2409-13116.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Chengkun Sun, Jinqian Pan, Russell Stevens Terry, Jiang Bian, Jie Xu. Generative models can enhance discriminative classifiers by constructing complex feature spaces, thereby improving performance on intricate datasets. Conventional methods typically augment datasets with more detailed feature representations or increase dimensionality to make nonlinear data linearly separable. Utilizing a generative model solely for feature space processing falls short of unlocking its full potential within a classifier and typically lacks a solid theoretical foundation.

arxiv-2410-21704.title: Stochastic Approximation with Unbounded Markovian Noise: A General-Purpose Theorem
arxiv-2410-21704.creator: Shaan Ul Haque, Siva Theja Maguluri *
arxiv-2410-21704.description: Abstract Motivated by engineering applications such as resource allocation in networks and inventory systems, we consider average-reward Reinforcement Learning with unbounded state space and reward function. Recent work [ 1 ] studied this problem in the actor-critic framework and established finite sample bounds assuming access to a critic with certain error guarantees.

arxiv-2505-12701.title: Counterfactual Explanations for Continuous Action Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2505-12701.creator: Shuyang Dong, Shangtong Zhang, Lu Feng
arxiv-2505-12701.description: Abstract Reinforcement Learning (RL) has shown great promise in domains like healthcare and robotics but often struggles with adoption due to its lack of interpretability. Counterfactual explanations, which address “what if” scenarios, provide a promising avenue for understanding RL decisions but remain underexplored for continuous action spaces.

pmc-10499326.title: Chimeric hemagglutinin split vaccines elicit broadly cross-reactive antibodies and protection against group 2 influenza viruses in mice
pmc-10499326.creator: Eduard Puente-Massaguer, Kirill Vasilev, Annika Beyer, Madhumathi Loganathan, Benjamin Francis, Michael J. Scherm, Guha Asthagiri Arunkumar, Irene González-Domínguez, Xueyong Zhu, Ian A. Wilson, Lynda Coughlan, Weina Sun, Peter Palese, Florian Krammer
pmc-10499326.description: Seasonal influenza virus vaccines are effective when they are well matched to circulating strains. Because of antigenic drift/change in the immunodominant hemagglutinin (HA) head domain, annual vaccine reformulations are necessary to maintain a match with circulating strains. In addition, seasonal vaccines provide little to no protection against newly emerging pandemic strains.

pmc-11547796.title: Food Consumption According to the NOVA Food Classification and Its Relationship with Symptoms of Depression, Anxiety, and Stress in Women
pmc-11547796.creator: Daniel Emiliano de Farias Xavier, Rúbia Cartaxo Squizato de Moraes, Thallyta Alanna Ferreira Viana, Joicy Karla Grangeiro Pereira, Paulo César Trindade da Costa, Davyson Barbosa Duarte, Melyssa Kellyane Cavalcanti Galdino, Adélia da Costa Pereira de Arruda Neta, José Luiz de Brito Alves, Vinícius Jo
pmc-11547796.description: Background/Objectives: Depression, anxiety, and stress are highly prevalent mental disorders worldwide, and food consumption can change in individuals with these conditions. We aimed to assess the food consumption of women with depressive symptoms and compare it to a control without symptoms.

pmc-11839624.title: Co-inoculation of Trichoderma viride with Azospirillum brasilense could suppress the development of Harpophora maydis-infected maize in Egypt
pmc-11839624.creator: Rasha M. Elmeihy, Omar A. Hewedy, Maryam S. Alhumaidi, Khadijah A. Altammar, Eman O. Hassan, Samah A. El-Debaiky
pmc-11839624.description: Plant diseases caused by fungal pathogens are responsible for severe damage to strategic crops worldwide. Late wilt disease (LWD) is a vascular disease that occurs late in maize development. Harpophora maydis, the causative agent of maize LWD, is responsible for significant economic losses in Egypt.

pmc-12225619.description: The simulation of gas flow in the bronchial tree using computational fluid dynamics (CFD) has become a useful tool for the analysis of gas flow mechanics, structural deformation, ventilation, and particle deposition for drug delivery during spontaneous and assisted breathing.

pmc-12712092.title: Dislocation analysis and structural characteristics of feal alloys under different heating rates using molecular dynamics simulation
pmc-12712092.creator: Ridwan Ridwan, Sudarno Sudarno, Wahidin Nuriana
pmc-12712092.description: In this study, molecular dynamics simulations are performed to investigate the dislocation behavior and structural characteristics of ferroaluminum (FeAl) alloys under different heating rates. This alloy has a remarkably low cost, is easy to fabricate, and exhibits good corrosion, sulfidation, and oxidation resistance, making it suitable for applications such as furnace fittings, heating elements, and heat exchange pipes.

pmc-12836774.title: Sepsis related multi-organ dysfunction: a global perspective on lung and gastrointestinal mortality and management framework

pmc-12836774.description: Current-day’s sepsis is reported as a life-threatening global health problem responsible for 11 million deaths and 50% of them were associated with lung and gastrointestinal infections. The present study aims to analyse available data from WHO mortality database for the assessment of worldwide lung and gastrointestinal sepsis mortality statistics.

pmc-13025036.title: Smart Nanoparticles Are Not Smart Enough (Yet): A Cell-Aware View of Cancer Nanomedicine
pmc-13025036.creator: Serena Marchiò
pmc-13025036.description: “Smart” nanoparticles are often presented as the vanguard of precision cancer therapy, defined by engineered abilities to sense predefined stimuli, enhance targeting, and control therapeutic release. Yet this notion of smartness remains largely material-centric and only partially reflects how nanomedicines behave in vivo.

pmc-13391878.title: Postoperative remodeling and developmental improvement of femoral trochlear dysplasia in pediatric habitual patellar dislocation
pmc-13391878.creator: Yanpeng Xu, Shaoqi Yang, Haiyang Jiang, Lin Huang, Shiqi Wan, Jiayao Song, Zhenqun Zhao, Chao Feng
pmc-13391878.description: BackgroundTrochlear dysplasia (TD) is a major contributor to habitual patellar dislocation (HPD). However, studies on femoral trochlear remodeling after HPD surgery in children under 10 years old are limited and have small sample sizes.PurposeThis study evaluated postoperative improvements in trochlear morphology and identified factors associated with trochlear development in surgically treated children <10 years old with HPD.

pmc-13445513.title: Thirst level trajectories and influencing factors in critically ill patients based on a group-based trajectory model: A prospective observational study
pmc-13445513.creator: Xing Shu, Shuang Yang, Aiping Hu, Jiang Yuan, Xin Liu, Zewen Pan, Zhongjun Cao, Mingfang Xiang
pmc-13445513.description: BackgroundThirst is widely recognized as a prevalent, severe, and often under-managed symptom in critically ill patients. Despite increased recognition of its importance in Intensive Care Unit (ICU) practice, the current management status of thirst has not substantially improved. Therefore, an urgent need exists to understand the short-term dynamics and influencing factors of thirst in this population.

pmc-13456324.title: Subacute Onset of Perineural Rhino-Cerebral Mucormycosis Mimicking Giant Cell Arteritis: A Case Report
pmc-13456324.creator: Ravi Ambati, David Prentice, Andrew Thompson, Chris Heath
pmc-13456324.description: A diabetic woman in her 40s presented with a subacute onset of a left temporal headache with no other symptoms, especially no visual or nasal symptoms. An initial diagnosis of giant cell arteritis was made due to a raised erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) and the presence of jaw claudication; however, the temporal artery biopsy was negative.

pmc-13617527.title: Navigating the immunosuppressive abyss: current hurdles and innovative breakthroughs in neoadjuvant immunotherapy for osteosarcoma
pmc-13617527.creator: Guanghao Chen, Minjie Hu, Zhongkun Li, Kunpeng Yang, Bao Chen, Tianhao Xu
pmc-13617527.description: Osteosarcoma is the most common primary malignant bone tumor of children and adolescents. Multiagent neoadjuvant chemotherapy once improved survival substantially, but outcomes have since plateaued. Delivering immunotherapy before surgery is attractive because the primary tumor, the tumor immune microenvironment (TIME), and the tumor-draining lymph nodes (TDLNs) remain intact.
